notes.title: v0.2.7a - factories patch
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As planned, there is a small patch coming up today. This patch brings the following that didn't make it in time for the v0.2.7 game update:

UPGRADES:
[list]
[*] All factories for the player-made space stations were updated to allow productions for all available equipment sizes and up to the prototype quality level of the item.
[/list]
FIXES:
[list]
[*]The new Construct Spawner (known also as Station Spawner) didn't restrict the stations in the system -> now fixed and the systems cannot have more than 5 player-made space stations.
[*]when constructing a new space station, the system didn't care about the NPC stations being close to the construction place -> now fixed and the new space stations cannot be too close to the NPC space stations.
[/list]
Regards,
Lukas Tokar

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The game development is slowly catching up on the plans put down in the development roadmap for 2023 and as a result of that, a big v0.2.7 game update is coming next week! As usual, the update starts at 10pm UK time and shouldn't take longer than 1 hour.

This update is mostly based on the feedback from the players and brings a lot of game-changer features, such as the limited NPC shops with all equipment in standard quality only to allow players to get new pieces of equipment even without building the stations - although it is still cheaper to build your own stations - so be sure to save up a lot of Courons! Now is the best time to get back into the game to save as much Courons as possible to get the equipment/ship you want!

Simplified Station Spawner and better Starmap are also included in this update, which will help a lot in building the space station anywhere you want (*limitations apply, see the change log below) and the Starmap will show you where exactly are the stations, what's the type of the station, who's the station owner and what's the relation between your factions.

There is still some work on the bug fixes, but the change log is pretty much done already, see it below this text here. Please read the Important section of the change log below, thank you.

Regards,
Lukas Tokar


[h1]v0.2.7 patch notes:[/h1]

	- [u]NEW FEATURES[/u]:

		[list]
[*] + 2 new HUD icons -> construct builder (new station spawner window) and communication (invitations window)
[*] 		+ new HUD popup window for tracking calcululation time left when using hyper jump
[*] 		+ new NPC shops in starting system 1-1 to provide players with equipment and ships in standard quality in exchange for Courons
[olist]
[*]  -> please keep in mind that these shops will be intentionally fairly expensive and with limited stock so that it is still cheaper to use player made space stations instead.
[*] 		-> When purchasing equipment items, be sure to check what size they are as you can only equip the same equipment size as is your current ship size.[/olist]
[*] 		+ big sized ships and equipment complete implementation
[/list]

	- [u]UPGRADES[/u]:

		[list]
[*] + HUD StarMap window rework:
[olist]
[*]  			+ new zoom in and zoom out effects when selecting sector / system
[*] 			+ Starmap automatically zooms in on the current system upon opening the Starmap HUD window, no matter which system was previously viewed
[*]  			+ you can now zoom in to the target system to see what the system offers (including info on player-made & NPC stations, your own location in the current system, planets exact location in the current system, asteroid borders [if the system has any] and danger zones [if the system has any])
[*]  			+ new translations to reflect reworked hyper-jump mechanism
[*]  			+ added info about time needed to calculate hyper jump route to the selected system
[/olist]
[*] 		+ hyper-jump rework:
[olist]
[*]  			+ player selects a system for hyper jump through StarMap HUD window. If the selected system is within hyper jump range and ship tank has enough fuel, the hyper jump button will become available to click -> upon pressing the jump button, the hyper jump route calculation will begin, for which a new popup window will appear with information about time left for the calculation
[*]  			+ once the route calculation is done, the player can then perform the hyper jump itself at any time he wants (in contrast to v0.2.6, hyper jump is no longer unstoppable once initiated, change was done to allow players to interrupt the hyper jump calculation time)
[*]  			+ fuel is only burnt out when the actual hyper jump is activated -> the hyper jump route calculation phase doesn't use fuel
[*]  			+ hyper jump route calculation will be completely cancelled at any time if the player gets destroyed / if the player lands somewhere with his ship / if a player manually moves to another system (this affects the already calculated hyper jump routes as well)
[*]			+ reduced the time needed to calculate the hyper jump route -> ship size modifiers to hyper jump wait time used to be 3/6/9 * target system distance for small/medium/big sized ships, now reduced to 2/4/6 * target system distance
[*]  			+ hyper jump now takes the players at the beginning of the target system, it can no longer take the players to the middle of the system
[*]  			+ new hyper jump info small HUD window -> displays the time left for the hyper jump calculation and switches to a button to activate the actual jump once the time is up. It is still possible to close this small HUD window and use the shortkey "J" (by default) to activate the jump instead.
[/olist]
[*] 		+ station spawning complete rework:
[olist]
[*]  			+ static station spawner buttons on the game map were removed
[*]  			+ players are now able to build a space station anywhere they want in the system
[*]  			+ added a new HUD window 'Station Spawner' with details of each station (including available factories, shop items and station HP). All available space stations to build are now ordered in a list. This was done to allow us to add more options in the far future:
[olist]
[*]				* smaller specialised platforms with defense turrets
[*]				* hospitals with the sole purpose of being a respawn option
[*]				* warp gate stations which would allow instant jump between allied warp gate stations anywhere in the galaxy as long as the player has enough fuel in his ship to cover the jump cost
[*]				* outpost stations which would generate control points for the faction in that specific system
[olist][*] 				** there is currently a plan for galaxy domination system which would make it possible to lock the system for a specific period of time, making the space stations invincible for the faction with the highest amount of control points and make any other faction unable to build a space station in that specific system.
[/olist][/olist]

[*] 			+ there are a few limitations for spawning a new station:
[*] 				- max 5 space stations per system
[*]				* each station has to be at least 1000 pixels (40 radar units) away from the nearest station (the stations are each around 500x500 pixels, so you can think of a 1 space station size empty space between space stations)
[*]				* the space station has to be at least 1100 pixels (44 radar units) away from the system borders
[*]				* players CAN NOT build a space station in a NON-PVP system (basically any system with RFPE owned station)
[/olist]
[*] 		+ HUD Radar adjustments
[olist]
[*] 			+ new visual representation of special zones (danger zones and asteroid system borders)
[*] 			+ new visual representation of stars (a big white circle)
[*] 			+ radar performance improvement -> changes done to reduce the number of radar processes for known entities near the player, making it work faster
[/olist]
[*] 		+ HUD missions window:
[olist]
[*] 			+ mission tab buttons got their UI background fixed, now their transparency depends on the general opacity settings
[*] 			+ added sound effect for hovering over the mission tab button and sound effect for clicking the mission tab button
[/olist]
[*] 		+ squadron member in HUD squadron window, mission tab button in HUD missions window, chat channel buttons in HUD chat window -> UI background fixed, now their transparency depends on the general opacity settings
[*] 		+ HUD communication window (formerly known as invitations window)
[olist]
[*] 			+ UI background fixed, now its transparency depends on the general opacity settings
[*] 			+ added 4 new switches, players can now choose to ignore (auto-reject) any requests / invitations they want
[/olist]
[*] 		+ HUD Chat window -> when not focusing on the chat text field and pressing the Enter key, focus the chat text field
[*] 		+ added respawn wait time info to the HUD Respawn popup window
[*] 		+ added info label for being in a non-pvp system
[*] 		+ improved station factory screen
[*] 		+ improved station shop prices screen
[/list]

	- [u]BALANCING[/u]:

[list][*]		+ increased the player ship reverse thrust speed to be max_speed/5 instead of max_speed/10
[*]		+ lowered the auto-slowing down speed when not pressing forward / reverse thrust buttons to be acceleration/3 instead of acceleration/1
[*]		+ adjusted system 1-1 in sector A1 -> raised the number of pirate ships NPC to 10
[*]		+ NPCs can now travel closer to the system borders
[*]		+ Refinery station factories balancing:
[olist][*]			+ now you need only 3 ores/ice to create 1 refined resource (used to be 10:1)
[*]			+ now you need only 5 scrap metals to create 1 iron (used to be 20:1)
[*]			+ production times reduced from 30 seconds to 10 seconds for each factory line
[/olist][/list]
	- [u]FIXES[/u]:
[list]
[*]		+ HUD Starmap window fixes:
[olist][*]			+ fixed client-side fuel cost calculation for hyper jump to selected system
[*]			+ changing equipped engine wasn't reflected in the Starmap client-side calculations for display info and just kept showing info for the engine equipped at the beginning of the playing session -> now fixed
[/olist][*]		+ it is now possible to quit the game any way you want -> though I highly recommend using the logout button while logged in to quickly save your player data (if you quit the game window in any other way, you can still stay on the game map for another 30 seconds) and using the exit button in the game's main menu to properly clear your memory of the game files.
[*]		+ localisation fix - updated error message for trying to unequip your current ship
[*]		+ when repairing your ship and viewing the ship hangar overview in the HUD equipment window, the tab view is changing from Hangar to Player / Ship - fixed now
[*]		+ fix for player-made Science Station shop -> Money chip item wasn't included in the list of items the station could trade with, thus making it impossible to acquire such item for the production in station factories
[*]		+ fixed the reward equipment items in the Station interior HUD window in missions section to show full HP instead of 0 HP
[*]		+ fixed equipped booster item expiry communication to the game client:
[olist][*]			+ added system message to inform player about such event
[*]			+ fixed the removal of the equipped booster item from the HUD equipment window
[/olist][*]		+ tweaked network updates for asteroids, which hopefully resolves the issue of asteroids being out of sync in the game client
[*]		+ leaving another ship's hangar when within the landing reach makes the player unable to land on that station until the player leaves the vicinity of the station and comes back -> now fixed to allow player to land on the station upon leaving another player ship hangar
[*]		- more fixes to come
[/list]

	- [u]IMPORTANT[/u]:

		+ Updated Terms and Conditions -> Project owner address change.
		+ Please note that I am going for my long summer holidays soon, so the next development will take place in the middle of this August after this update is released. So the next game update can be expected in September.
		+ This summer will be dedicated to adjusting the NPC population of the game map systems in the sector A1, updating the out-dated in-game helper called WoTUpedia, adding game map background to systems 4-x and 5-x, and lastly writing new missions.

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The update will start at [u]10pm UK time on 26th May[/u] and shouldn't take longer than 1 hour. [b]The game server will be unavailable during the update installation.[/b] Once the server is updated, the new game version will be available for download here on Steam.

The new version will bring some important fixes as well as some new features, upgrades of existing features and balancing adjustments, some of which are based on the feedback from the players! More details on the upcoming update will be published during the next week in the patch notes board on this forum.

The update is actually coming 3 months later than planned due to my health issues and other personal stuff, including finding and moving to another house. My health is back to normal now and all other stuff is also sorted out now, so I am focusing on catching up with the development roadmap I published on the official game forum earlier this year.

Thank you for your understanding and allow me to once more apologise for the late delivery of the update and lack of communication from my side.

Regards,
Lukas Tokar

[h1]v0.2.6 patch notes:[/h1]

	- [u]NEW FEATURES[/u]:

		+ implemented new mission type -> wreck collecting, regardless of what the wreck contains (although no such mission is available yet in the game)
		+ new player to player direct trade feature ->
			* players can now directly trade with another player while in open space.
			* players can trade with Courons and up to 4 items.
			* players put the Courons and items in their part of the trade window (left side), then confirm via a button that everything from their side is Ok. Confirmation is automatically cancelled if either side changes their offers.
			* once both players mark their offers as confirmed, the trade happens and both the Courons and the offered items are moved from each player to the other player.
			* trade can only be activated if both players are not docked (not landed on a station / planet / ship hangar), both players are alive and close to each other. The trade is cancelled automatically at any time if any of the mentioned requirements are not met anymore.
		+ added Property screen in faction section in Station Interior where faction members can see faction owned stations and their details (exact position in the galaxy, station name, station type, courons stored on that station, safety points amount, safe zone status and current HP).

	- [u]UPGRADES[/u]:

		+ Game Settings window -> improved keyboard settings layout
		+ HUD chat window -> chat channel is automatically switched to Squadron channel upon joining a squadron
		+ HUD chat window -> script simplified for better overall performance
		+ HUD chat window -> upon entering the game, the chat window will add a prompt to the global channel about using chat command '/help' to see available chat commands.
		+ HUD targeting popup window -> now has 2 option buttons if a player is selected: to invite the targeted player to a squadron or to offer a trade with the targeted player. Player to Player trade can only be offered this way for now.
		+ HUD mission window -> when the selected mission slot doesn't have an active mission, the window now tells the player to land on a space station to accept a new mission
		+ HUD mission window -> if the active mission has a condition for completing the tasks in order or if only certain amount of tasks done are required to finish the mission, the message with such condition is now placed at the top of the active mission description
		+ HUD invitations window -> reprogrammed for better performance and usage

	- [u]BALANCING[/u]:

		+ medium sized repair robots now repair higher amount of HP
		+ medium sized ships now have more HP
		+ ranged weapons now deal less damage but have increased fire rate (to properly compensate for the long weapon range)
		+ standard energy and projectile weapon types (neither ranged or heavy weapons) now deal more damage and have decreased fire rate (to properly balance this type of weapon between ranged and heavy weapons)
		+ standard explosive weapons (neither ranged or heavy weapons) have increased fire rate (to properly balance this type of weapon between ranged and heavy explosive weapons)
		+ small sized repair combat droid qualities now repair higher amount of HP to actually have the effect of the higher item quality

	- [u]FIXES[/u]:

		+ big radar fix -> a typo caused radar being unable to differ between NPC and player ships which might have resulted in the radar not working properly, including wrong colour change to red for the nameplates of the players without a faction
		+ big squadron fix -> a typo caused squadron members not being updated properly (squadron membership, squadron member positions, etc.)


	- [u]WORTH MENTIONING[/u]:

		+ some time was spent on creating new tools for the game development, which include game map data editor, game map background editor and missions editor -> all tools were made to simplify the development of the game, making it a lot faster and more enjoyable for us developers.
		+ big sized ships and equipment are now part of the game, although inaccessible yet -> will come with the next game update.
		+ beginner system 1-1 will receive an NPC shop in the next game update -> the decision was made based on feedback from the players being unable to get another piece of equipment for a way too long period of time. This NPC shop will belong to the RFPE (allied) NPC race and will have a limited amount of each equipment available to each player. The shop will be expensive, but this shop will include all ships and equipment in the standard quality only, making every player able to get another equipment he wants and needs.
		+ preparations are being done to introduce 2 new NPC races, one of which will be present in a couple of systems of the sector 1-1.
		+ preparations are being done to introduce medium and big sized ships for NPC race Rebels and RFPE, to provide some challenge for players with stronger and bigger sized ships.

			* players can now directly trade with another player while in open space.
			* players can trade with Courons and up to 4 items.
			* players put the Courons and items in their part of the trade window (left side), then confirm via a button that everything from their side is Ok. Confirmation is automatically cancelled if either side changes their offers.
			* once both players mark their offers as confirmed, the trade happens and both the Courons and the offered items are moved from each player to the other player.
			* trade can only be activated if both players are not docked (not landed on a station / planet / ship hangar), both players are alive and close to each other. The trade is cancelled automatically at any time if any of the mentioned requirements are not met anymore.

+ added Property screen in faction section in Station Interior where faction members can see faction owned stations and their details (exact position in the galaxy, station name, station type, courons stored on that station, safety points amount, safe zone status and current HP).

notes.title: Game update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

The time has come to bring the 1st game update since the game launched in December last year.

The update will start at 10pm UK time on 27th January and shouldn't take longer than 1 hour. [b]The game server will be unavailable during the update installation.[/b] Once the server is updated, the new game version will be available for download here on Steam.

This new version of the game comes with some new features, adjustments, balancing and bug fixes. Some of the new features, bug fixes and adjustments were made based on the feedback we have received on the official forum of the game. Thank you all for your input! I hope you'll keep supporting the game development further.

Regards,
Lukas Tokar

[h1]v0.2.5 patch notes:[/h1]

	- [u]NEW_FEATURES[/u]:

		+ Game title screen now shows the game version installed
		+ added new checkbox in the game settings window in the General tab to dis/en-able targeting popup window
		+ added new chat command '[b]/players[/b]' which returns the amount of currently online players
		+ added new battle alarm to space stations -> every time the station loses 1000 HP, a warning message is sent to all currently active faction members, specifying the name of the station, the system the station is in and the info on how many thousands of HP are left
		+ added new in-game remember login credentials option -> new JSON file will be created in the Documents/WoTU directory of your PC with stored accounts. This file contains login name and hashed password (no plain text password ever leaves the game for security reasons, so the password is unreadable for any other users).

	- [u]UPGRADES[/u]:

		+ Game map loading mechanism simplified -> the game is now loading less data upon entering the game / entering new system, resulting in a faster and proper game map loading. This change also ensures that no duplicate objects are created as it is possible to quickly move to another system and back. Originally, all border systems were loaded along the current system, but now only the current system is loaded and the border system is loaded only once the player gets too close to it and such system keeps being loaded until that system is no longer a current / border system. Further performance updates are planned as sometimes the screen freezes for a brief moment upon loading new border system.
		+ Radar colours changed -> originally, faction members had green radar dot and green nameplate while allies had blue nameplates and blue radar dots. These colours were now swapped so that allies are green and faction members blue.
		+ Placeholder button for colonising a planet is now hidden to not confuse the players with this yet not available feature
		+ changed access to the station spawners -> now only factions are able to build space stations. Additionally, the player has to have the 8th right "Station master" assigned to his rank.
		+ ship radar rework -> the code was simplified, which might result in fixing the game crashing issue (although its root cause still remains a mystery to me as this never happens in the development environment)
		+ ship/station wreck rework -> the wreck code was simplified, which might result in fixing the game crashing issue

	- [u]BALANCING[/u]:

		+ cheaper space stations (Courons price down)
		+ raised player made space stations max HP

	- [u]FIXES[/u]:

		+ station settings -> policy update fix (there was a typo making updating the policies impossible)
		+ fixed thrusters -> a bug occurred after flying and stopping still in open space, the ship thrusters stayed visible, now they are correctly hidden once the player ship stops in the open space
		+ fixed ship Ant -> missing weapon scripts were causing issues with this small ship and for other players around the player with this ship
		+ faction warehouse fix -> moving the items inside faction warehouse didn't immediately update for other players
		+ station shop fix -> sometimes the station refused to sell / buy items even when the station had enough item amount or Courons and saying that the station doesn't have enough Courons to pay.
		+ localisation bug fix -> transaction popup when buying / selling items was unable to show Czech special characters in the item name

Originally, all border systems were loaded along the current system, but now only the current system is loaded and the border system is loaded only once the player gets too close to it and such system keeps being loaded until that system is no longer a current / border system. Further performance updates are planned as sometimes the screen freezes for a brief moment upon loading new border system.

+ Radar colours changed -> originally, faction members had green radar dot and green nameplate while allies had blue nameplates and blue radar dots. These colours were now swapped so that allies are green and faction members blue.
+ Placeholder button for colonising a planet is now hidden to not confuse the players with this yet not available feature
+ changed access to the station spawners -> now only factions are able to build space stations. Additionally, the player has to have the 8th right "Station master" assigned to his rank.

+ ship radar rework -> the code was simplified, which might result in fixing the game crashing issue (although its root cause still remains a mystery to me as this never happens in the development environment)
+ ship/station wreck rework -> the wreck code was simplified, which might result in fixing the game crashing issue

tags.balance_change: + raised player made space stations max HP

tags.bug: + station settings -> policy update fix (there was a typo making updating the policies impossible)
+ fixed thrusters -> a bug occurred after flying and stopping still in open space, the ship thrusters stayed visible, now they are correctly hidden once the player ship stops in the open space
+ fixed ship Ant -> missing weapon scripts were causing issues with this small ship and for other players around the player with this ship
+ faction warehouse fix -> moving the items inside faction warehouse didn't immediately update for other players
+ station shop fix -> sometimes the station refused to sell / buy items even when the station had enough item amount or Courons and saying that the station doesn't have enough Courons to pay.
+ localisation bug fix -> transaction popup when buying / selling items was unable to show Czech special characters in the item name
